title: Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A classic Middle Eastern dish featuring tender lamb, vibrant spices, and juicy freshness. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner or outdoor gathering.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together kebab spice mix, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and onion.
Add lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread lamb cubes, bell pepper, and onion onto skewers.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until lamb reaches 145°F (63°C).
Let kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as rice, salad, or pita bread.
